status: PINNED 2026-08-16 — the authoring surface, signed off with the all-shells ruling (Q-v2-5 amended: every shell landed enabled in one pass; F0 closed)
vocabulary: shell > view > widgets; the hub is the routed root frame (/) hosting the stage shells (header, tabbar, rail chrome + body outlet); ceremony shells route bare
_comment: Single authoring surface per DESIGN-ARCHITECTURE registry canon: composers write this,
the designer consumes it; models/screens_model/registry.json is a derived projection.
Widget `kind` values come from the closed vocabulary in
`composedFrom` declares a recipe where no single kind realises the widget;
`presentation` marks island-realised surfaces with no kit widget. Resolves F4.
VISUAL PARITY LAW: v1 (designs/appbox-studio/) is candidates-only for STRUCTURE
(never copy file layout) but is the established VISUAL design SSOT — theme,
per-view layout and component appearance carry over; each entry's `design.visualSource`
cites the v1 view it restructures. Deviations are findings, not silent redesigns.

seed.portalo: simulated design content for the design shell canvas — Portalo is NOT a studio shell; assets under assets/portalo/

widgets.name: header
widgets.note: hub-owned brand + project chip + locale/prefs; hosted shells receive it through their header_panel

widgets.name: tabbar
widgets.note: compact-rung navigation over the hosted stages (entries carrying `tab` in this registry); hub-owned

widgets.name: rail
widgets.note: expanded-rung navigation; same destinations as the tabbar; hub-owned

widgets.name: footer_panel
widgets.note: root-rendered once outside the rungs; a hosted shell feeds the body or the panel does not render

design.instruction: the routed root: / renders the hub chrome with the default hosted stage (studio_dashboard_shell.studio_dashboard) in the body outlet. Boot-guarded per R3 (docs/plans/studio-v2-boot-sequence-wiring.md): an un-booted session redirects to /startup?to=<target>; ceremony shells are exempt

widgets.name: header_panel
widgets.note: shell-owned panel hosting hub-hosted header widget; body-only <nav> strip, no single kind realises it

widgets.name: footer_panel
widgets.note: shell-owned body-only strip; body is the caller's content (e.g. the timeline <ol>)

widgets.name: main_panel
widgets.note: hosts gate strip + project grid + stats + wizard entry; own chrome is the per-shell segmented panel bar (tabs) — hosted widgets carry their own recipes

widgets.name: gate_strip
widgets.note: needs-you gates; each names project + stage, decision is a manual POST

widgets.name: project_grid
widgets.note: v1 project tiles; `current` is data from the seed, never inferred

design.instruction: v1 established look: theme tokens via abx* constants, gate cards, project tiles with stats; restructure, do not redesign

widgets.name: boot_checklist
widgets.note: landed/ready state rendered before approving — no animation until per-shell approval judged

design.instruction: splashscreen is NOT a shell — mobile splash surface + brand logo only
splashscreen is a SURFACE, not a shell (Q-v2-1): brand wordmark only, mobile-first, no chrome; satisfies the roster law's splash role
ceremony shell; cutover per Q-v2-5 behind user validation
consumes session, produces credentials; per-shell manual trigger to proceed
v1 interview thread look carries over; produces intake/registry.json

widgets.name: design_canvas
widgets.presentation: canvas island (runtime/vendor canvas.js + inspect.js) — no kit widget realises it
widgets.note: desktop = full studio; tablet canvas shows tablet+mobile of designed app; mobile canvas shows mobile only; inspect on all devices

design.instruction: designed-app content is Portalo (seed.portalo); v1 canvas/inspector layout restructured, not redesigned
